reason: Each FR-09 requirement maps to an assertion that fails if it is violated. /healthz 200 {"status":"ok"} with no key: test_fr09.py:126 and :129. /readyz 200 when the DB is up and at head: :145. /readyz 503 when the DB is down: :169, and the body names "database" at :172. /readyz fails closed with 503 when the migration is behind (v2 vs v3): :198, and the body names "migration" at :201. /v1/metrics admin returns 200 with exact task counts by status at :239-241, latency percentiles at :242-244 and rate-limit rejections at :245. The rejection count is only >=1, but the test provokes a real 429 first, so a counter stuck at 0 would fail. A write-scope key gets 403 at :265. Neither the no-auth requirement for the health endpoints nor the metrics admin gate is violated without an assertion failing.
